title: code_leads
description: The code reader's answer at setup at a start midway (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 108): its concerns about one file of the inherited code where the parsers see developed code, each naming the exact text of the file it is about. Code keeps a concern only when grep finds that text in the file, and attaches it as a lead to the verification of the inherited result that uses the file.

leads.description: each thing about the file a verification of the results built on it should look into: a value fixed in one place and another elsewhere, a default that disagrees with what the file says it does, an unseeded random draw, a step that is skipped or done twice; nothing about style

text.description: the concern, one or two sentences a verifier can check

item.description: the exact text of the file the concern is about, as the file writes it: a name, a call, an assignment
